justification: Adds a live check to outreach claim OC-8: every served number's sentence must be printed word for word on its cited PDF page. Before this, OC-8 passed on a page number, a sentence and a link -- 641 served numbers were summaries and OC-8 stayed green. No served output changes; this is a claim check.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a planted fake quote, a changed number, the right words on the wrong page, or an unreadable PDF leaves OC-8 green
falsifiable_check.observed_red: test_a_planted_fake_quote_goes_red: 'Minimum side setback 0.9m (DCP 3.2.3)' against a page holding the council's sentence -> FAIL not_found. Live run on prod after #1560: PASS, 0 of 167 served numbers.

pre_impl.existing_data: OC-8 = every_served_number_is_cited + DQ-39 + public-link query; served rows via outreach_claim_checks.served_entries (the serve path). 235 served rows, 167 carry a number.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Expected 235 checked; the serve path yields 167 entries with a value (notes with no number are skipped, the same rule every_served_number_is_cited uses).
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reuses dcp_quote_status.classify (the serve gate's own matcher) so the claim check and the gate cannot disagree; does not trust stored quote_status.
pre_impl.external_source_error: R2 or pypdf failure -> page texts None -> classify no_source -> FAIL (never PASS). Registry unreadable -> UNKNOWN with the reason.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: None for site users. For the team: a red OC-8 names up to four failing rules (council/type: verdict).

functions.name: mismatches
functions.input: served entries as (lga, entry dict, urls) plus a function giving page texts for a council and chapter
functions.output: count of numbers checked and a list of 'council/type: verdict' for every number that is not verbatim
functions.if_none: page texts None means the PDF could not be read, classified no_source and listed as a failure

functions.name: check
functions.input: nothing; reads served entries through the serve path and chapter PDFs from R2 via the registry
functions.output: OC result tuple of PASS, FAIL or UNKNOWN with a message naming the failing rules
functions.if_none: serve path or registry unreadable returns UNKNOWN with the reason, never PASS

queries.purpose: chapter PDF per council and chapter
queries.where_clause: dcp_chapter_registry WHERE is_active AND r2_current_path IS NOT NULL, keyed on (council, chapter_key)
queries.if_zero: every number is no_source, so OC-8 FAILS
queries.if_wrong: a wrong PDF can only fail a rule, never pass it, because the match is exact

break_it.scenario: A served number's sentence is a summary, not the council's words.
break_it.what_happens: Classified not_found and OC-8 turns red, naming the rule.

break_it.scenario: One digit of the number differs from the PDF.
break_it.what_happens: Classified not_found and OC-8 turns red, naming the rule.
break_it.how: No fuzzy matching anywhere in classify.

break_it.scenario: Right words, cited page two or more pages away.
break_it.what_happens: Classified wrong_page and OC-8 turns red, naming the rule.
break_it.how: Only the cited page and its page-break neighbours count.

break_it.scenario: The chapter PDF cannot be fetched or has no text layer.
break_it.what_happens: Classified no_source and OC-8 turns red rather than green.
break_it.how: classify returns no_source for missing pages; only verbatim passes.

break_it.what_happens: OC-8 word part returns UNKNOWN with the reason, which is not a pass.

post_merge.secrets: none added; uses existing DATABASE_URL and R2_* from .env
post_merge.manual_verify: python scripts/oc8_quote_words.py prints PASS 0 of N; python scripts/outreach_claim_checks.py OC-8 shows the new line.
